clips.title: The story
paras: The Deathstalkers' Report is a crucial military courier assignment delivered to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher. After securing injured Deathstalkers in the northern wilds, you carry their gathered intelligence concerning unexpected Scourge activity back to Forsaken high command. This dispatch alters the Forsaken's assessment of their hold on Silverpine Forest.

The Deathstalkers act as the eyes, ears, and daggers of the Dark Lady, pushing into the untamed wilderness ahead of standard military units. Near the border of Tirisfal and Silverpine, an advance patrol ran into catastrophic resistance while charting enemy movements. Though Deathstalker Quinn barely survived his injuries and Erland fought his way to safety, their scouting mission yielded intelligence essential to the Forsaken occupation of Silverpine Forest.

When High Executor Hadrec reviews the sealed field report, it confirms dark news: the mindless forces of the Scourge have maintained a far heavier and more aggressive presence in Silverpine than Undercity strategists anticipated. Instead of merely securing abandoned human hamlets and pacifying rogue beasts, the Sepulcher command must brace for coordinated Scourge opposition while fighting to claim the region.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible. It has information that is vital to the Forsaken's occupation of Silverpine.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you discover the fate of the Deathstalkers?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I hadn't accounted for the level of Scourge presence we've seen in Silverpine Forest, nor for the troubles our Deathstalkers have had in their scouting efforts.
Your aid to our Deathstalkers was invaluable, friend. And you will be commended.
